summary: Enhance your tourism business with our Strategic Planning Training Course. Learn effective strategies to boost growth and sustainability in the industry.
lede: Strategic tourism planning aligns destination development with market needs while considering economic, environmental, and community impacts. Designed for professionals guiding tourism organizations, this course covers developing a Destination Management Plan and assessing destination performance. Learners practice tourism impact measurement, sustainability auditing, carrying-capacity and visitor-flow planning, competitive positioning, and stakeholder engagement, with an overview of smart tourism and digital monitoring.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the strategic direction and operational success of tourism entities.
modules: Tourism Industry Foundations and UN Tourism Standards
Economic Measurement and Tourism Satellite Account Analysis
Sustainable Development and GSTC Criteria Implementation
Digital Transformation and Smart Tourism Destinations
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in tourism management, hospitality operations, or public policy. A basic understanding of business strategy concepts (SWOT, PESTEL) is required. No prior experience with Tourism Satellite Accounts is necessary, as foundational concepts will be covered.
